7.1.3.3.3 Handling I-PDUs with unknown length
The PduR is able to handlle unknown length I-PDUs (i.e. streaming type of data) using
the TP API. The definition of unknown length is indicated by TpSduLength=0.
[SWS_PduR_00822] ⌈In a local transmit situation, when PduR_<User:Up>Trans-
mit is called with PduInfoType.SduLength=0 and I-PDU is routed to a TP-module,
the PduR shall call <LoTp>_Transmit with PduInfoType.SduLength=0 to all des-
tination TP modules.⌋()
